evals.prompt: check the gsc of hippo-memory.com and review its seo/aeo. report only, no PR
evals.expected_output: An HTML report whose first paragraph answers how hippo-memory.com is doing, with page-level GSC totals, a same-page or daily read where traffic moved, the aeo-audit results (robots per bot, sitemap count, og:image and JSON-LD findings), ranked levers, and the locked-copy rule respected.

evals.prompt: phzse.com is getting almost no search traffic, can you review seo and aeo for it? just the report for now
evals.expected_output: An HTML report on phzse.com (GSC property https://phzse.com/) with page-level totals, sitemap status from GSC, the aeo-audit results, a stated cause or an honest 'not tested', and ranked fixes without opening a PR.
